status_definitions.missing: The upstream behavior has no Mochi implementation.
status_definitions.partial: Mochi implements only part of the upstream behavior.
status_definitions.paired_independent: Upstream and Mochi have separately executed assertions for a similar narrow behavior; this is not a shared-fixture or output-differential proof.
status_definitions.blocked: Verification cannot proceed until an external prerequisite is available.

verification_model.note: The parity harness runs selected upstream Cargo tests and selected Mochi tests independently. A passing paired check establishes coverage, not whole-product parity.

behaviors.description: Trusted native Mojo source plugins compile through a content-addressed cache and run behind a strict process protocol with shadow-generation reload.
behaviors.gap: The live protocol is still serial v1: it lacks bidirectional host calls, per-call cancellation, concurrent request IDs, dynamic callbacks, OS sandboxing, and most of the Maki plugin API.
parity_criteria: Negotiate a bounded bidirectional protocol with cancellation, deadlines, concurrent IDs, and generation tagging.
Expose the complete engine-neutral Maki registration, context, host-call, rich-result, event, keymap, prompt, slot, and UI-handle surface through the Mojo SDK.
Contain native processes so fs_read, fs_write, net, run, and env grants cannot be bypassed through direct system calls.

local.normalization: Exact registration, command, Maki-shaped tool result, Unicode NDJSON, cache miss/hit, version floor, failed-build cleanup, shutdown, source rebuild candidates, and unit-tested shadow replacement logic.

behaviors.verification: Unit and real compiled-subprocess checks cover this initial tranche; the listed protocol/API/security gaps remain unimplemented.

behaviors.description: Run Maki Luau plugins, including the bundled plugin set, without rewriting them for another host protocol.
behaviors.gap: Mochi now builds trusted Mojo sources and launches executables through mochi.plugin JSON-RPC, but it does not execute unchanged Luau, reproduce Luau semantics, expose the complete maki API, or provide Maki's sandbox guarantees.
parity_criteria: Load unchanged Maki global, project, package, and bundled Luau plugins.
Match the maki API surface, sandbox, grants, reload, cancellation, async, tool, command, keymap, and UI callbacks.
Pass upstream plugin-host and bundled-plugin behavior fixtures through the Mochi runtime.
behaviors.verification: No executable parity check exists; status is based on source inspection at the pinned revisions.

behaviors.description: Evaluate Maki's global and project init.lua configuration and maki.setup tables with the same layering, validation, reload, and fallback behavior.
behaviors.gap: Mochi loads declarative JSON objects through AppConfig; it does not execute init.lua or implement maki.setup, package declarations, plugin options, or last-good Lua reload fallback.
parity_criteria: Execute the same global then project init.lua scopes and accept the same maki.setup schema.
Produce equivalent merged config, plugin/package options, permission inputs, diagnostics, and reload fallback.
Honor Maki's --no-plugins recovery semantics while retaining bundled tools.
behaviors.verification: No executable parity check exists; config.layered.merge covers only Mochi's declarative merge, not Lua configuration.

behaviors.description: Expose the complete Maki built-in tool catalog with matching schemas, defaults, output limits, permissions, and execution semantics.
behaviors.gap: Maki documents 21 built-in tools (20 enabled by default and insert_lines opt-in); Mochi standard_tool_definitions registers seven: read, write, edit, list, bash, code_execution, and task.
parity_criteria: Provide all 21 documented tool names with byte-compatible input schemas and default enablement.
Match Maki output, truncation, annotations, permission scopes, cancellation, and side effects for each tool.
Cover batch concurrency and the Maki code_execution interpreter policy, not only similarly named commands.
behaviors.verification: No full-catalog check exists; existing invocation and runtime tests exercise only Mochi's seven-tool subset.

behaviors.description: Implement Maki's Claude-Code-compatible, bidirectional stream-json SDK protocol.
behaviors.gap: Maki accepts --input-format stream-json and continuously exchanges system, user, assistant, result, stream-event, and control messages; Mochi accepts one prompt and emits one result object for both json and stream-json output formats.
parity_criteria: Accept the same stream-json input/control message shapes and process multiple turns on one process.
Emit the same ordered system, assistant, tool, stream-event, control-response, and result envelopes with compatible identifiers.
Compare normalized transcripts from shared protocol fixtures in both implementations.
behaviors.verification: No bidirectional SDK oracle exists; --output-format stream-json currently shares Mochi's one-shot JSON result path.

behaviors.description: Match Maki's live full-screen TUI and multi-session concurrency, including background progress and focus switching.
behaviors.gap: Maki supervises one App and agent runtime per live session and drains background events while only the focused session renders; Mochi's line-oriented _interactive loop owns one Session and performs prompt runs synchronously.
parity_criteria: Keep multiple agent sessions live concurrently and drain events, queues, tools, cancellation, and persistence while backgrounded.
Match new, focus, list, rename, delete, notifications, status, and per-session permission isolation.
Exercise the real terminal event loop with deterministic multi-session schedules.
behaviors.verification: No live terminal or concurrency oracle exists; current UI tests cover reducer-level behaviors only.

behaviors.description: Match Maki's provider matrix, native protocol adapters, model metadata, authentication, request options, and image inputs.
behaviors.gap: Maki has 15 ProviderKind variants plus dynamic/custom routing and vision adaptation. Mochi has native OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Copilot paths and OpenAI-compatible aliases, but no demonstrated matrix equivalence; _legacy_messages rejects images and the Anthropic/Gemini body builders skip image blocks.
parity_criteria: Cover every Maki provider kind and custom/dynamic route with equivalent endpoint, auth, headers, retry, timeout, streaming, and option semantics.
Match model catalogs, tier selection, context/output limits, pricing, thinking, fast mode, and vision capability handling.
Round-trip image inputs through every supported native protocol and apply the same text-only fallback.
behaviors.verification: Existing paired checks cover selected parser and contract fixtures, not the provider matrix or image transport.

behaviors.description: Persist live sessions with Maki's coalesced O(delta) JSONL appends, cursor validation, rollback, retry, and shutdown draining.
behaviors.gap: Maki StorageWriter maintains SessionLog cursors and appends deltas off the UI thread; Mochi SessionStore.save serializes every record and atomically rewrites the whole JSONL file on each save.
parity_criteria: Append only new messages, tool outputs, subagent messages, and changed metadata while cursors remain valid.
Detect divergence or external truncation, roll back torn appends, rewrite safely, retry failures, and drain queued writes at shutdown.
Demonstrate crash recovery and bounded write amplification under shared mutation traces.
behaviors.verification: Existing session checks cover codec and truncated-tail reads, not incremental writer durability or write amplification.

behaviors.description: Derive bash permission scopes from a parsed shell AST and fail closed for complex or invalid commands.
behaviors.gap: Maki's bash plugin uses a tree-sitter Bash parser to collect simple command segments and force prompts for complex/error trees; Mochi ToolRegistry.prepare treats the entire command string as one scope and generalizes it by splitting on spaces.
parity_criteria: Parse shell syntax into the same permission segments for simple pipelines and command lists.
Force a prompt on substitutions, redirects, complex constructs, parse errors, or unavailable parsers exactly where Maki does.
Compare scopes and decisions over a shared adversarial shell corpus.
behaviors.verification: No shell-AST check exists; deny precedence and session generalization tests do not cover scope extraction.

behaviors.description: Place the real terminal cursor on the rendered input cell so display-width wrapping and IME preedit anchoring match current Maki.
behaviors.gap: Current Maki tracks the exact wrapped cursor cell, including wide characters, and calls Frame::set_cursor_position for macOS IME anchoring. Mochi _render_editor moves left by a codepoint count on a single printed line and does not calculate wrapped display-cell coordinates.
parity_criteria: Compute cursor row and column in terminal display cells across wrapping, wide Unicode, combining text, and viewport changes.
Park the real terminal cursor on the visible cursor cell so macOS and other IMEs anchor preedit text correctly.
Verify cursor coordinates in a pseudo-terminal against shared width/wrap fixtures.
behaviors.verification: No cursor-position or IME check exists; current UI reducer tests do not observe the terminal cursor.
